gloss: to look back; to turn around and look; to get back at someone by proving oneself

definitions.gloss: to look back; to turn around and look
definitions.explanation: To turn one's head or body to look at something behind or beside oneself.

definitions.gloss: to get back at; to prove oneself; to show them
definitions.explanation: To succeed or achieve something impressive in order to prove wrong those who doubted, looked down on, or criticized you.

examples.english: Someone called out to me, and I turned around to look.

⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}って→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧{見返|みかえ}る⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I turned around to look, no one was there.

examples.english: I want to work hard and prove everyone wrong.

examples.english: I worked desperately to prove wrong those who laughed at my failure.

notes:
A godan verb ({見返|みかえ}った, {見返|みかえ}って, {見返|みかえ}らない) with two distinct meanings. Sense 1 is a simple physical action. Sense 2 carries strong emotional motivation — the desire to vindicate oneself and prove doubters wrong.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見返|みかえ}して→見返す：14217_mikaesu⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: I'll show them! / I'll prove them wrong!
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見返|みかえ}す→見返す：14217_mikaesu⟧: to prove everyone around you wrong
- バカにした⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見返|みかえ}す→見返す：14217_mikaesu⟧: to get back at people who looked down on you

SIMILAR WORDS (sense 1):
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to turn around; to look back — more common for this physical meaning
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{向|む}く→振り向く：04232_furimuku⟧: to turn to face someone — implies facing toward

SIMILAR WORDS (sense 2):
- ⟦{見返|みかえ}す→見返す：14217_mikaesu⟧: to look back at — can also mean to get revenge/prove oneself (similar)
- ⟦{仕返|しかえ}し→仕返し：10597_shikaeshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get revenge — more direct retaliation
